summary: Defines the URN namespace identifier adid for Advertising Digital Identifiers, used to identify advertising assets.

eli5.summary: A standard name tag format for ads.

questions: what is the ad-id company prefix
subtitle: A global naming system for advertising assets across all media platforms.

tldr.problem: The advertising industry needs a standardized way to identify advertising assets uniquely across all media platforms such as television, online, and mobile.
tldr.mechanism: RFC 8107 defines the 'adid' URN namespace, which represents Advertising Digital Identifiers as a formal Uniform Resource Name following a specific eleven or twelve-character structure.
tldr.outcome: Ad-ID provides a global standard for identifying and tracking advertising assets, enabling greater transparency and consistency across the advertising supply chain.

today: RFC 8107 is an Informational RFC published in March 2017. It remains the formal standard for the Ad-ID URN namespace and has not been obsoleted. Ad-ID continues to be the industry standard for identifying advertising assets across media platforms.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content:
An Ad-ID is the industry standard for identifying advertising assets across all media platforms including broadcast television, online, mobile, and point-of-sale displays. Each ad gets a unique eleven-character ASCII code (or twelve characters for HD or 3D video). RFC 8107 formally registers the 'adid' URN namespace identifier, allowing Ad-IDs to be used as Uniform Resource Names within internet systems.

Beyond just identifying which ad is which, Ad-ID also provides descriptive metadata: advertiser name, brand, product, commercial title, and product categorization. This metadata can be retrieved using the unique code, making Ad-ID useful for advertising inventory management and audience measurement across platforms.
sections.eli5: An Ad-ID is a special code that identifies every advertisement. Think of it like a unique serial number that helps everyone know which ad they are watching or reading, no matter where it shows up.

sections.title: The Ad-ID Structure
sections.content:
An Ad-ID consists of three parts. The first is a four-character alphanumeric Company Prefix (not starting with zero). The second is a seven-character alphanumeric code. Together these form an eleven-character base code.

For video, an optional one-character Video Format Identifier can be appended: 'H' for High Definition or 'D' for Three-Dimensional. This allows the same creative asset to have different codes for different video formats. For example, 'ABCD0001000' is a standard definition ad, while 'ABCD0001000H' is the HD version of the same creative.

The formal URN syntax is: urn:adid:ABCD0001000 or urn:adid:ABCD0001000H. Lexical equivalence is case-insensitive, meaning uppercase and lowercase versions are treated as the same identifier.
sections.eli5: An Ad-ID code has a company section, then a specific ad section, and sometimes an extra letter for HD or 3D versions. It works like a postal code: the first part tells you who made the ad, and the rest identifies which exact ad it is.

sections.title: Registration and Management
sections.content:
Advertising Digital Identification, LLC is the official registrant responsible for managing the Ad-ID namespace. They maintain a central registry and ensure each Ad-ID is unique by checking against existing identifiers. Once assigned, an Ad-ID is never reassigned or reused, and the binding between the identifier and its resource is permanent.

Ad-IDs are generated through Ad-ID's proprietary registration procedures, and Ad-ID URNs are resolved using URN resolvers maintained by Ad-ID. The validity of a URN-ADID can be checked using Ad-ID's web services.
sections.eli5: One company, Advertising Digital Identification, LLC, is in charge of handing out Ad-IDs and making sure no two ads get the same code. Once an ad gets a code, that code always belongs to that ad.

sections.title: Benefits and Use Cases
sections.content:
The primary benefits of Ad-ID adoption are transparency and accountability in the advertising marketplace. By using a universal identifier, the industry can eliminate costly errors associated with inconsistent identification of advertising assets throughout the supply chain.

Ad-ID enables more granular audience measurement across multiple platforms. Advertisers, agencies, and media companies can all use Ad-ID to unambiguously identify advertising assets and retrieve underlying metadata. This standardization helps track where an ad has been seen, who saw it, and how it performed across different channels.

The system also supports media planning and buying by providing a common language for discussing advertising assets, reducing confusion when campaigns span multiple platforms and media types.
sections.eli5: Ad-ID helps everyone in the advertising business speak the same language about ads. It stops mistakes and helps count how many people saw an ad on different websites and TV channels.
